function: Soft actor-critic DRL jointly sets device and UAV transmit power, device CPU frequency and UAV positions to trade FL learning latency against data-distribution distance (pp. 6-7).
system: Single-antenna ground devices upload to hovering UAVs with K=4 antennas (virtual MIMO); air-to-air UAV links; 2 GHz carrier, 1 MHz bandwidth; no RIS (pp. 3-4, 9).
method: Soft actor-critic DRL (five networks, entropy regularization, replay buffer) for power, CPU frequency and UAV deployment, alternating with non-learned greedy device association; hierarchical FL trains CNNs (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Own air-ground simulator: probabilistic LoS/NLOS pathloss [36], i.i.d. CN(0,1) small-scale fading, free-space air-to-air; FL data CIFAR-10 and MNIST; devices random in 1000 m square (pp. 4, 8).
test_conditions: SAC training and test conditions are not described; results swept over 30-120 devices, per-cluster power 0-2 W and energy budget 60-140 J (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Ideal (unlimited resources), Random association, HierFedAvg, ELASTIC: association or selection schemes; none described as a learned power or deployment method (p. 9).
metrics: Global model accuracy and learning utility (weighted learning latency and data distance) versus epochs, number of devices, per-cluster power and energy budget (pp. 9-11).
complexity: none; only a qualitative low-complexity remark on greedy association (p. 6).
q1_support: p. 4: "A realistic channel model considering both LOS and NLOS component is utilized to capture the ground-to-air (G2A) channel [36]"; own LoS/NLOS pathloss with i.i.d. CN(0,1) fading, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "The number of EDs ranges from 30 to 120 to manifest the effectiveness of our proposed scheme"; a parameter sweep only, with no statement that a trained policy is tested on conditions unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 9: "EDs randomly form clusters and connect to UAVs without considering the communication link and data distribution" (Random baseline); the four baselines are association schemes, none an earlier learned power or deployment method.
q4_support: p. 6: "to achieve low-complexity device-cluster matching"; qualitative only, with no complexity order, operation or parameter count, or runtime for the SAC or the greedy step.
q5_support: p. 8: "are adopted to train the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and verify the proposed scheme" (CIFAR-10, MNIST); learning-task datasets do not count, channels are own simulation, and no code or data link is given.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Borderline inclusion: FL aggregation is digital, so not area 7. The SAC learns transmit power of aerial links (physical layer under the aerial rule, p. 7 action space) jointly with UAV deployment and CPU frequency, so it passes above_phy and fits area 6. If the reviewer reads the FL latency objective as above the physical layer, exclude as above_phy. Device association is greedy and non-learned.
